payload.text: hv cuts Utilz 2.14.9, 0132's fix, through devbin's core once 0132 lands (hv in vc's window, 2026-11-02, before the clock read 07:36Z by date -u): the first consumer cut in the new shape, ST0011 WP10 (utilz#ST0031). utilz-vc and utilz-dc bring vc and hv one plan first: tests.yml fires on candidate/** and not on tags (today it fires on main and tags, so pre-flight would refuse); tools/post-cut against the macOS leg the cut now runs at the release commit; a build: block wired to the cache. Its release check and dry run come to vc before hv cuts; every run books on this desk. After the cut vc reads its RELEASE seal for AC-3.4 (sign and notarise at the release commit as a leg), Utilz's part of AC-4.3, and AC-5.4 if a build: block is in. GO (hv in vc's window through the TUI, and in utilz-vc's at 08:22Z, Utilz vc decision 87; recorded 2026-11-02 08:23Z by date -u): utilz-vc's plan as sent. ST0031/04 by utilz-dc: U1 tests.yml (candidate/** trigger, tags dropped, macOS jobs on candidate refs) and U2 post-cut (app steps go; it keeps macos publish, since the 0.1.19 cut attaches no app); then R1 post-cut 2.14.8 smoke, R2 release check, R3 dry run, each booked here; hv pushes main and vc reads CI; then hv's cut with a freeze. The build: block is not in this cut. After the cut, vc files the core asks still wanted (0.1.20's formula step already covers 'pull the tap'). RESUMED at hv's go of 2026-11-05 (decision 144), on devbin 0.1.20: utilz#0132 landed at efdd047d and closed at 58e45281, so the cut's precondition is met; ST0031/04's records are in at c475fae3; utilz-dc stopped before step 2 (U1; U2, post-cut doing the macos publish, the formula publish and the tap pull with no second signing; the prez line at CHANGELOG.md:18); the resume orders, ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-vc/RESUME.md and ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/RESUME.md, were written for 0.1.19; Utilz's main is 7a6a06a7, the 0.1.20 sweep. 0.1.20 moves the plan in three places, for utilz-vc's and utilz-dc's revision: notarisation reads one notarytool profile, so hv runs bin/devbin macos store-creds once on each Mac that cuts, before R2 (todo 197); release.formula: true (0323) can make the formula publish and the tap pull a step of the cut where a formula command is active, both of which U2's post-cut was to do; and pre-flight refuses an unignored in-tree app or build root (0313), so the hand check with git check-ignore is moot (Menuz builds out of tree in any case). vc's check of U1 carries cc's hold 35 (decision 144): test-macos, the rust matrix's macOS row, menuz-app and Test Summary's MACOS_REQUIRED all run on candidate refs, as devbin's own tests.yml does, or the candidate reads green on Linux alone. AC-5.4 cannot come from this cut: no build: block, and Menuz builds out of tree.
